gold: Lepromatous leprosy with type 2 leprosy reaction (T2R)

selector.rationale: Diffuse infiltrate of foamy histiocytes and numerous acid-fast bacilli are not typical for Sarcoidosis, but the presence of asymptomatic nodules, uveitis, and lymphadenopathy are more consistent with Sarcoidosis than other options

rejected.label: Rheumatoid Arthritis
rejected.why: elevated rheumatoid factor but lack of other typical findings and presence of contradictory evidence such as asymptomatic nodules

rejected.label: Leprosy
rejected.why: presence of numerous acid-fast bacilli is more typical for leprosy, but other findings such as uveitis and lymphadenopathy are not typical

rejected.label: Lupus vulgaris
rejected.why: lack of typical findings such as skin lesions and presence of contradictory evidence such as asymptomatic nodules
